opening.argument: The video presents a current-affairs lesson for competitive-exam preparation, not a financial opportunity. Its title identifies it as a daily current-affairs lesson, and the speaker frames the material around news students should know and questions they may face in exams. Slides address substantive lesson topics, including the Skill India Mission and how supercapacitors store energy. The referral-code subscription discount is an ordinary commercial promotion separate from that instruction. Nothing in the cited lesson material links the discount to an investment promise or another deceptive mechanism.
